title: Dockside Initiation — The Golden Path
summary: A tight, authored ~10-minute onboarding on the Solenne docks, guided by Dockmaster Jax. Teaches movement, combat, healing, and trade, plants the Veil-resonance hook off the training drone, and ends on a player choice that sets a faction lean and spawns the first real quest.

guide.name: Dockmaster Jax
guide.role: Dockmaster of the Solenne landing bays
guide.voice: Weathered, dryly funny, quietly kind. Has watched a thousand drifters pass through and outlived most of them. Talks like he's done you a favor by warning you.

setting.locale: The Solenne docks, edge of the Severed Reach
setting.mood: An unsettled frontier port. The Concord flies its banners over the upper docks; the freighter crews and Drift Cartel runners below know better.

coldOpen: Welcome to Solenne. Dockmaster Jax — I run these landing bays. New face, empty pockets, that look in your eye like the galaxy already owes you something. I know the type. Stick with me and I'll make sure your first week isn't your last.

beats.title: Planetfall
beats.objective: Get your bearings on the docks.
beats.narration: First thing you do anywhere new: learn to walk before you run. There's no shame in being careful — the careless ones I bury.

beats.title: Find Your Feet
beats.objective: Move to Dockmaster Jax using WASD or the arrow keys.
beats.narration: Arrow keys or W-A-S-D. Get a feel for the deck plating under you, then come find me. I don't bite — not before midday, anyway.

beats.title: The Dockmaster
beats.objective: Talk to Dockmaster Jax and accept 'Dockside Initiation'.
beats.narration: As it happens, I've got work. Call it 'Dockside Initiation' — it'll teach you the four things that keep a drifter alive: move, fight, mend, bargain. You in?

beats.title: The Training Drone
beats.objective: Defeat the training drone. Watch the turn order and pick your action.
beats.narration: The drone hits back, but it won't kill you — much. Watch the turn order on the left, choose from the action menu, and aim for the thing trying to dent your skull. Go.

beats.title: The Resonance Spike
beats.narration: …Hold on. That drone's core just spiked — resonance readings climbing right off my board, and they're pointing at you, not the machine. I've watched Veil-touched come through these bays before, but I've never seen one light up by accident. We'll get to that. First, you're bleeding on my deck plating.
beats.payoff: Plants the central mystery: something in the player is Veil-touched. Pays off in the closing choice (the resonance fragment) and the first real quest.

beats.title: Patch Yourself Up
beats.objective: Buy a medpac from Jax's stall.
beats.narration: Medpacs: field medicine in a tube. Crack one and it knits you back together — mid-fight or after. Out here a full pack is worth more than a full clip. Buy a couple.

beats.title: Use What You Carry
beats.objective: Open your inventory (press I) and use the medpac to restore health.
beats.narration: Press I to open your kit. Find that medpac and use it. A weapon keeps you in the fight; a medpac keeps you in the world.

beats.title: Reading the Room
beats.objective: Note your health, stamina, credits, and level in the HUD.
beats.narration: Top corners tell you everything that matters: what's keeping you alive, what's keeping you moving, and what's keeping you fed. Glance at them often. The ones who don't end up as a line in my ledger.

beats.title: The Wider Reach
beats.objective: Open the galaxy map to see where you can go.
beats.narration: You've got the basics, and you're still breathing — that's better than most manage. Pull up the galaxy map. The Reach is wide, and for the first time it's open to you.

closingChoice.trigger: After the galaxy-map reveal, Jax stops the player before they leave.
closingChoice.setup: Before you wander off — I dug this out of the drone's core after you fried it.

item.name: Veil Resonance Fragment
item.description: A shard pulled from the training drone's core, faintly warm and humming at the edge of hearing. It is keyed to whatever stirred in you during the fight.

closingChoice.prompt: It's a resonance fragment, and it's keyed to whatever woke in you back there. I can't read it, but I know two people who can. A Keeper contact on Caldon — Order folk, they live and breathe Veil-resonance — or a buyer on Sinkport, Drift Cartel, no names and no questions, pays in full. Your fragment, your call. Where's it going?

options.label: Take it to the Keeper contact on Caldon.
options.response: The Order, then. Figures — you've got that look. Caldon's a quiet world and the Keepers are quieter, but they keep their word. Tell them Jax sent you.

options.label: Sell it to the Drift Cartel on Sinkport.
options.response: Sinkport it is. Coin spends, mysteries don't — can't fault the logic. The buyer's fair by their standards, long as you don't count your fingers after. Tell them Jax vouched.

recap.title: You're On Your Way
recap.headline: You've learned the four things that keep a drifter alive.
learned: Move with WASD or the arrow keys
Fight turn-by-turn — read the order, pick your action
Heal with medpacs from your inventory (press I)
Trade at vendors — standing changes the price
Travel the galaxy map to take on quests across the Reach
recap.closer: The Reach is wide and it doesn't care about you — but Jax does, a little. Now get going.
